Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.26.5:

- The exported HC report now includes an 'FDC Classification Agent — Endpoint Compatibility' section whenever DSPM or Classification is in scope and FDC OS selections were made on the Agent Compatibility step. It shows a per-OS support table with Microsoft Office support (Microsoft 365 / Office 2024 / 2021 / 2019 / 2016) and the same findings (uncertified OS, EoS OS, unsupported Office combinations) shown in the wizard.
- The wizard and the report share one analysis engine, so on-screen and PDF results always match.
- Earlier in this series: the F1E + FDC agent switch in the OS / Browser Support Matrix, the FDC agent panel in Agent Compatibility, DSPM + FDC Product Lifecycle pages, and auto-populated DSPM/FDC version rows in Version & EoS.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
